BOOK NOW

OFFICIAL TOUR OPERATOR | GUARANTEED ENTRY

There's a moment on race morning in Corvara when the valley goes quiet, thousands of riders hold their breath at the start line, and then the mountains simply open up in front of you. That's the Maratona dles Dolomites — not just a Gran Fondo, but a day you'll measure the rest of your season against. For one day a year, seven of the most legendary passes in cycling are closed to everything but bikes: Campolongo, Pordoi, Sella, Gardena, Giau, Falzarego, Valparola. Choose the full Maratona and take on all seven, or the Medio or Sellaronda if you'd rather taste the magic in a shorter dose.

Our Maratona dles Dolomites cycling tour is built around that one unforgettable day — but the whole week earns its place. Our guide team, former pro riders who know these roads inside out, will be beside you from the first pedal stroke to the last descent.

We are OFFICIAL TOUR OPERATOR for Maratona dles Dolomites 2027

This mean that by booking this trip you will have GUARANTEED ENTRY to the event.

What's included

  • 5 Nights in the stunning Hotel Soleil 4-stars or Hotel Rezia 3-stars superior. Both in La Villa few hundreds meter from the startline.
  • 5 spectacular days of cycling
  • 5 Buffet breakfast at the hotel
  • 5 Dinners at the hotel
  • Airport transfers including bike and luggage transfers at the below details. Private transfers can be also organised at a supplement.
  • Maratona dles Dolomites Entry in the 3rd starting grid (Women will be upgraded to 2nd grid)
  • Cigala Cycling Maratona dles Dolomites special edition jersey
  • Every day guided cycling routes by our ex pro, experienced and friendly guides.
  • Every day full Pro Experience with a full back up vehicle
  • Support during the event on Sunday (feed zones, mechanical assistance)
  • Pro tips by our ex pro staffs
  • Snacks & water on route each day
  • GPX files sent in advance

What's not included

  • Flights
  • Lunches
  • Single room supplement at €70/night
  • Bike Rental starting from €260 depending on bike specs
  • Travel insurance
  • Massages

- 13:00 pm 
- 19:30 pm

05/07/2027

- 6:00 am 
- 9:30 am

 

Looking to come to a different time and different airport? We can offer private transfers. Just get in touch for a quote.

 

TRIP AT GLANCE

START & FINISH LOCATION: La Villa, Alta Badia

DAYS RIDING 5 days

TOTAL DISTANCE 250-350 km apprx

GROUP SIZE:: 20 max (2 groups on the road each day divided on abilities)

LEVEL: Open to anybody

LONGEST DAY: Day 5 - Maratona dles Dolomites

DAY TO DAY BREAKDOWN

GPX files will be sent before the trip.

ARRIVAL DAY AND SHAKE DOWN RIDE
25km | 600mt

Arrive in Alta in Badia, check into your hotel and get set up with your bike fit. In the afternoon, we ease into the mountains with a shakeout ride up Passo Valparola — steady, scenic, and just enough to shake off the travel and get a first proper look at where you'll be racing in a few days' time. Welcome dinner in the evening to meet your guide team and fellow riders.

THE SELLARONDA
65km | 1800mt

The big one before the big one. Today we ride the full Sellaronda loop, circling the Sella massif over four legendary passes: Campolongo, Pordoi, Sella and Gardena. It's one of the most iconic rides in cycling — closed roads, endless switchbacks, and some of the finest mountain scenery anywhere in the Alps. Lunch trailside with the peaks in full view, back to Corvara by evening.

GARDENA & CAMPOLONGO
50km | 1000mt

Two of the Maratona's classic passes in one day. We climb Passo Gardena first, winding up through pine forest into open alpine meadow with the Sella towers rising ahead, then drop back toward Corvara before taking on Passo Campolongo — shorter, sharper, and a proper leg-opener for what's still to come this week. Lunch trailside, back to the hotel by early afternoon.

REST DAY OR COFFE RIDE
30km | 200mt

A day off the bike to recover before race day. Explore Alta Badia, relax at the hotel, or join an easy optional spin if you're restless. Race briefing in the evening before a carbo loading meal ahead of the big one the next day.

MARATONA DLES DOLOMITES
138km | 4230mt or 106 km | 3130mt or 55 km | 1,780 m

This is what you came for. Start line in Corvara alongside thousands of riders, then the full Maratona course — Campolongo, Pordoi, Sella, Gardena, Giau, Falzarego, Valparola — seven passes, closed to traffic, all for you. Our guide team will be on course and at the finish to see you home. Celebration dinner in the evening.

LEAVING DAY

After an unforgettable week of riding, exploring, and experiencing the magic of the Dolomites, it’s time to say arrivederci.

Whether you’re heading home or continuing your travels, we hope you leave with tired legs, great memories, and a deeper love for cycling.

Grazie mille for being part of the journey—and we hope to ride with you again soon!

EVENT GALLERY

WHERE YOU WILL STAY

Hotel Rezia
Our base for the early part of the trip, Hotel Rezia is a family-run hotel in La Villa, right in the heart of Alta Badia — the kind of place where the welcome feels personal because it is. After a big day in the mountains, sink into the wellness area (sauna and steam bath) before dinner, or just watch the peaks change colour from the terrace as the light goes.

Hotel Soleil
Located in the heart of La Villa, at the foot of the famous Gran Risa, Soleil Alpine Lifestyle Hotel combines contemporary Alpine design with the traditional character of South Tyrol. Surrounded by the spectacular Dolomites, it provides an elegant and comfortable base for experiencing Alta Badia and the iconic roads of the Maratona dles Dolomites.

The hotel offers modern rooms, excellent dining, wellness facilities including an indoor pool, sauna and steam bath, as well as dedicated cycling services and guided bike tours. Its central location makes it an ideal base for exploring the legendary Dolomite climbs and the Sellaronda.

BIKE RENTAL

There are many options available, depending on your measures and budget we work with you to find the best bike for you. From standard mechanical groupset and alloy wheels to electric shifting and carbon wheels.

Road or Gravel E-bikes are also available.

FRAMESET: Bianchi, Wilier, KTM

GRUPPO: Sram Rival/Force AXS, Shimano 105, Ultegra, Durace Di2 and Mechnical

PEDALS: Bring your own

SADDLE: Selle Itala

WHEELSET:  Alloy, Carbon

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to bring my own bike, or can I rent one?

You’re welcome to bring your own bike, or rent one for the week. After booking, you will receive a form to fill out via email. You can let us know there and in the case you want to rent, you will see an option to fill up details for your measurements. 
You can choose a range of bikes: road, gravel or e-road bike.

What fitness level do I need for this trip?

This trip suits Beginner, Intermediate and Expert riders. The core Maratona dles Dolomites routes are approachable for most fitness levels — during the day of the event you have the option to choose a longer or a shorter route based on your fitness level.

What kind of support is included on this trip?

A daily support van follows the group throughout the trip, giving you the full pro experience. It carries spares, snacks, drinks, and any spare gear or jackets you want to shed mid-ride.

During the Maratona dles Dolomites, we set up our own dedicated feed zones along the route — just like the pros get. You’ll find snacks and drinks stocked and ready, and you can drop off your own bidons or specific nutrition ahead of time so it’s waiting for you when you ride through. Our team is on hand at each zone, and there’s basic mechanical assistance available too, just in case you need a quick fix to keep going.

Is there a single room supplement?

Yes, a single room supplement is available and you choose it during the booking process.
